title: Prove conditional influence bounds and separate the global guards
claim: Classify shared descent and counterfactual rosters, fresh holdings, closure and signalling under both ordinary laws, with explicit edit type, forward and backward cones, built counterexamples and two-weighting sampled comparisons plus the explosive archive.
standard_statement: Causal cones under matched changes to the initial physical holdings at funded complete cuts.
prior_work: The earlier timing theorem covers inclusive shared ancestry. Global funding and parity closure and the one-step lookahead bounds predate this study.
source_contribution: Multi-step shields, surplus-only coupling, matched sharp local/remote edits and the limits of reading the binary outcome.

validation.status: Within-study checks on both physical knot laws, independently replayed receipts and exact enumerations. External program referee pending.

attained_result: In ordinary funded nonclosing growth, witnessed distance is the exact delay to shared descent. At separation d an edit only to positive loose counts can first change a matched price at d or a receiver birth at d+1. An edit to witness data matched outside its charged sites can do so at d−1 and d for d≥2. General receiver shields are sharp at radii n for rosters and n+1 for prices; the identified class needs n for both, and pure products have a uniform first-neighborhood shield. Both laws have a global funding veto, and parity alone can reveal the presence of a disconnected live part through a positive local terminal birth. A raw single-incidence edit and current serial recomputation have separately stated meanings.
scope: Finite connected lawful starts, physical presentations with one or two holders of each distinction, complete funded cuts under parity and not-all-equal. The bounds concern arbitrary matched rooted witness neighborhoods or edits with specified supports in the union of the two initial witnessed ends. Closure, original funding, passive local decoding and raw serial scheduling are qualified separately. The size-independent lower bounds use actual lawful preparations. No time units or population claim.
